post.description: O-Kam account credentials are sent to vendor HTTPS services. Password is never persisted. Returns HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie and a Bearer session token for API clients. Protect both as secrets. If a bridge access token is configured, authenticate this request with Authorization: Bearer <bridge-access-token> (or Basic bridge:<token>); Compose web gateway supplies its private gateway header automatically. Sessions expire after 12 hours and are revoked on logout/restart.

post.summary: Send a validated native camera action
post.description: Requires a connected viewable camera. Commands execute serially in its existing native session. state=confirmed means result=0; sent means transport delivery only; rejected carries firmware result. Queue timeouts never execute later. Commands can change persistent settings; call only intentionally. Action definitions and parameter ranges are in x-actions. Image ranges: brightness/contrast 0..255, orientation 0..3, night 0..2. plaintext_password configures documented ExUserSwitch external access; it does not prove ONVIF/RTSP services exist. Verify get_params + independent service probe afterwards.
